segments.scribe: John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)
segments.text: Under the ordinances of this city
I move that when property is sold at sherriff

segments.scribe: John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)

segments.text: sail the persons having their property sold shall have the priviledge to redeem the same by paying

segments.scribe: John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)
John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)

segments.text: charges within thirty days after sale

segments.scribe: John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)
John C. Bennett (first-listed of: John C. Bennett; Joseph Smith Jr.; James Sloan)
